en: I prefer the feel of bills. I like making deposits in cash, and there's something about pulling them out of my wallet to pay.
I guess I just like that interaction with people. Watching the digits of your bank account go up and down is lame.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's an interesting way to look at it. Bills are much more fun to see in action. I would keep mine in a safe at home instead of at a bank.<Color:Default>
Man, I wish I had big stacks of money to keep in a safe. Even just a small stack would be nice...
Do you go out drinking every night, Shinada-san?
Yeah. Being home alone is a drag. When I have the time, I come around here to drink.
Not every night. I don't have the time or money to live like that.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I see. I didn't have any experience partying downtown while I was in school, so I don't know this part of town very well.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yes. As a result, I am rather curious about the other clubs in the area.<Color:Default>
Want me to tell you about them? I've been to almost all of them at least once, so I can let you know what they're like inside.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really? Yes, please do! It's not an easy thing to simply ask people.<Color:Default>
Well, it's easy enough for me to talk to other guys about it, but it's harder with a woman. Ladies might not like what they hear.
A lady like you shouldn't know. It's better if you don't involve yourself.
<Color:255,200,200,255>When you say it like that, it seems like you're keeping this big secret from me. Do all men know about this?<Color:Default>
I... I wouldn't say we all do.
Why not work there yourself?
<Color:255,200,200,255>That... isn't really feasible. Hence, why I'm asking like this.<Color:Default>
Well, speaking as someone who's written articles on the subject, it's best to go yourself if you can.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm quite interested in people with unusual jobs. I love customers who share interesting stories, even if they're infrequent visitors.<Color:Default>
What sorts of jobs?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Let's see. There was a man in here who I specifically recall was a bed tester.<Color:Default>
A bed tester?
Is that some kind of sex thing? Like he gets to experiment with bedroom play?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Goodness, no! And whatever do you mean by "bedroom play," anyway?<Color:Default>
Oh, so it's not that? Heh.
<Color:255,200,200,255>All he does is sleep on the fancy bedding used by high-end hotels, and then writes up reports on how comfortable they are to sleep on.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>It's such a strange way to make a living. Imagine being paid to lie in bed from morning till night!<Color:Default>
Whoa, sounds like my kind of gig!
It's better to have a normal job. If they don't visit often they must not have the dough, so I can bet being in a relationship with them would be a real buzzkill.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Do you think so? I would figure that someone with an ordinary job would only have ordinary stories to tell.<Color:Default>
Ordinary's fine. I slacked off in school, so I don't know anything about economics or politics. But I do know a ton about baseball and sex work.
To a guy like me, even the grumblings of some everyday businessman can offer plenty of surprising insights.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I get what you're saying, but I simply wouldn't find that sort of conversation particularly enjoyable.<Color:Default>
Hey, different strokes for different folks, right?
It's not just about work. Some people are fun, some people are boring. It really depends on the person.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, I suppose, but...<Color:Default>
Besides, hearing stories about some random weird job over and over is going to get old. You'd be sick of it in no time.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, perhaps you're right. Repeatedly hearing the same story does wear on my nerves after a while.<Color:Default>
Is work all you talk about? There are other things in life, you know. You could talk about current trends or... I dunno, other stuff.
<Color:255,200,200,255>But those are topics that hostesses and their customers already discuss. We hear the same kinds of things repeated constantly.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>So unless you come from some unique background, it isn't easy having an engaging conversation.<Color:Default>
Ah. I suppose if I weren't in the sex industry, I'd be pretty boring, too.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Shinada-san, are you dating anyone currently?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Roughly how many?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, you mean you're only dating one person?<Color:Default>
Well yeah, of course. Do I look like some kind of playboy to you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, yes.<Color:Default>
Sorry, I lied. I don't really have a girlfriend.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh. How disappointing.<Color:Default>
Aw, hey now...
I haven't counted. Let's see, how many was it?
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh my, sounds like quite a few! You're quite the playboy, Shinada-san.<Color:Default>
Ain't I just, though? Hahaha.
No, I'm not. I'm single right now.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well now. Why is that?<Color:Default>
Beats the heck outta me.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I think men should be able to have relationships with two or three women simultaneously.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I feel like those who insist they're only seeing one person are lying to themselves.<Color:Default>
Yeah, it takes skill for a guy to cheat! I used to dream about dating girls all over Japan at once.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh my, really?<Color:Default>
Well, my job had me traveling the country, so I thought since I had the opportunity, it would be awesome to have a girlfriend in every city.
It'd make away games more fun, and make me more motivated about doing my job.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Men with many lovers really do get their job done! Why not make that happen now?<Color:Default>
Sure thing. What do you say we start off with Nagoya?
That's what love is. There's something sweet and pure about only having one person in your life.
<Color:255,200,200,255>So, if multiple women made advances toward you, you would turn them all down, Shinada-san?<Color:Default>
Of course. I won't be swayed by other girls if I already love someone.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Not even if they were stunningly gorgeous, or some wealthy heiress?<Color:Default>
Of... Of course not!
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh my, I'm impressed you could turn that down.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I'm sure your girlfriend would be happy to hear that!<Color:Default>
Would she be? Er, I mean, of course she would. Because I definitely do have one...
See? I'm a total catch. So why can't I get a girlfriend?
I don't think I could.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Exactly. Men are inclined to cheat. That's why I find it far more preferable for them to be forthright instead of sneaking around.<Color:Default>
Heh, you've seen right through me.
How about you, Shion-chan? Would you date a bunch of guys at once?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I would never be so despicable!<Color:Default>
Whoa, why's it okay for a guy to do it, but not a girl? Isn't it usually the other way around?
<Color:255,200,200,255>A lady may have many boyfriends, but only a single lover. A line has to be drawn somewhere, doesn't it?<Color:Default>
So a guy can't assume he's your only man? That's not very fair of you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Are you good at hiding things, Shinada-san?<Color:Default>
Sure. I grew up in a competitive environment, so I've got a pretty good poker face.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Oh, is that so?<Color:Default>
Huh? Is something wrong?
Not at all. My personality isn't really suited to lying, so any attempts I make at deception fall right apart.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hehe. I do get that impression from you.<Color:Default>
See? And I'm poorer for it.
I don't really know. Maybe people see through my lies and just don't tell me. Maybe my lies have been exposed without me even knowing about it.
<Color:255,200,200,255>That is true. There's no guarantee how long your lies will hold up.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>I don't want somebody I date to keep any secrets from me whatsoever.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's why I'm hesitant to have a relationship with someone who is a skilled liar.<Color:Default>
Good call. Lies lead to fights, after all. It's best to be honest with each other.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Shinada-san, wouldn't you be upset with your partner if you found out they lied to you?<Color:Default>
Not at all. If they came clean about it, I'd be okay.
But if a secret is going to make things worse, it's best to just get it out in the open.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You are quite the admirable gentleman!<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Perhaps I would be okay coming clean about my secrets to a person like that.<Color:Default>
Hey, I know I'd be A-OK with it!
Depends on what it was about. Sometimes you have no choice but to lie if it'll protect someone.
If I found out someone had been lying to me for a reason like that, I wouldn't be mad at them, as long as I agreed with the reason.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Yes, I see. I suppose it's difficult to simply come clean about something if you don't know whether the other person will be upset or not.<Color:Default>
Yeah, but that's just a risk you have to take sometimes.
That's not realistic. People tell all sorts of lies, big and small. You have to let the little things slide.
<Color:255,200,200,255>And what if the secret in question was something you couldn't simply "let slide", as you say?<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>Well, so for example, um... If I were to say that I, ah, actually used to be a man...<Color:Default>
Wait, what!? Are you serious?
<Color:255,200,200,255>I said I was only being hypothetical, didn't I?<Color:Default>
Geez, talk about bad timing. Considering the topic of our current conversation, it makes me think your hypotheticals might actually be the truth.
No big deal! I don't judge.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Really!? You're so open-minded, Shinada-san. I could stand to learn from your example.<Color:Default>
Haha, don't be so sure about that.
So, what about you?
<Color:255,200,200,255>What about me? I mean... I don't want to lie to someone I'm in love with.<Color:Default>
<Color:255,200,200,255>That's why I wish I could date someone who just takes me as I am. I don't have the emotional wherewithal to be so open.<Color:Default>
I didn't expect you to be so shy. You always seem so brazen. I'm kind of surprised.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hehe! That's because us Nagoya women are notoriously stubborn. It's nothing more than an act.<Color:Default>
Even so, it takes strength to face your inner self. There are lots of things about myself I'm still fighting with.
<Color:255,200,200,255>You deal with that too, Shinada-san? Then we have that in common! Can you tell me about them?<Color:Default>
Um, maybe at some point. But I'd rather not talk about it right now.
I wouldn't worry about it. If someone has real feelings for you, they'll accept you no matter what, Shion-chan.
<Color:255,200,200,255>Do you really think so?<Color:Default>
Sure thing! Heck, I'm living proof of that!
<Color:255,200,200,255>Hehe! You sure are confident! Then perhaps I should open my heart and mind completely.<Color:Default>
If the person is good. You don't need to date some jerk who won't accept you.
<Color:255,200,200,255>I wonder. I can't tell yet whether the person in question is good or not.<Color:Default>
I see. So he must be a flake, huh? Maybe he's not such a great guy after all.
There sure are lots of cars here in Nagoya. They say the world is moving away from using automobiles, but you'd never guess looking around here.
Is that so? There aren't more cars in places like Tokyo or Osaka?
Nope. There are way more here. I bet you have a car, don't you, Shion-chan?
Of course. Is that not normal?
Nagoya has a car culture, so it's not out of place. Metropolitan Tokyo has a good rail network, so you don't need a car.
But we have trains here in Nagoya as well.
But you still drive everywhere, don't you? Why do you think that is?
